ModMetaData.name: [42G]Glowing Bushes [Forked]

ModMetaData.description:
Q: What does this mod do?: A: This mod increases the visibility of certain plants by adding a noticeable glow effect.
Q: Want an Even Bigger Glow? A: The glow size can be easily adjusted by using this mod's settings.
Affects: • Strawberry Plants • Wild Berry Bushes • All Healroot Plants • Ambrosia
Mod Support: • Heat-resistant Ambrosia - Alpha Animals • Wild Raspberry Bushes - Regrowth 2 • Wild Blueberry Bushes - [SYR] Wild Blueberry Bushes
Odyssey DLC: • Wild Strawberry Plants
